en: The Discourse on the Full Understanding of Denial.
This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant; thus have I heard:
"Bhikkhus, one who does not directly know denial, does not fully understand it, and fails to dispassionately detach the mind from it and abandon it, is incapable of the destruction of suffering."
“Monks, by directly knowing and fully understanding hypocrisy, and by causing the mind to fade away from it and abandoning it, one is capable of the destruction of suffering.
Thus the Blessed One spoke. Regarding this, it is said:
“Having fully understood that slander by which beings go to an evil destination, [one should abandon it].”
Those who possess insight abandon them;
having abandoned them, they never again return to this world.
This matter too was spoken by the Blessed One; thus have I heard.
